title: Envision Aimbot
features:
Envision Aimbot
Updated 9/26/23

I made an undetectable aimbot script that's configurable and has many configs for your preference.

Features
- Aimbot,
- Mouse emulation,
- Save & load configs,
- ESP,
- Tracers,
- Bounding boxes,
- Highlights,
- Trigger bot,
- Aimbot predictions, 
- Keybinds

Many other configs are in the loader/source.
